chunks: The blood money (diyyah) for a Jew, a Christian, and a Magian is four thousand dirhams, four thousand dirhams, because they are People of the Book.

key_terms.أَرْبَعَةُ آلَافِ دِرْهَمٍ: four thousand dirhams; the specified amount of compensation
key_terms.دِيَةَ: blood money; the prescribed financial compensation for unlawful killing

ai.seo_question: What is the diyyah of a Jew, Christian, or Magian in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the diyyah of non-Muslim protected communities identified here as Jews, Christians, and Magians. It assigns their blood money as four thousand dirhams and grounds that ruling in their being regarded as People of the Book.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "The blood money (diyyah) for a Jew, a Christian, and a Magian is four thousand dirhams, four thousand dirhams because they are People of the Book."
